definitions.localSend: Captured Enter keydown to pending-message DOM and next requestAnimationFrame callback.
definitions.typing: Captured printable keydown to the textarea input event and next requestAnimationFrame callback; actual typed value is asserted before sending.
definitions.rendererStream: Validated renderer bridge snapshot callback to matching assistant text DOM and next requestAnimationFrame callback. This is a frame opportunity, not a physical display timestamp.
definitions.visibleUpdateGap: Time between frame callbacks containing distinct streamed versions, including first injection to first rendered frame. Includes transport and coalescing; no provider/network latency.
definitions.controlledTransport: E2E event injection to renderer bridge callback, including fixture/main controller/IPC/preload parsing. No provider or network timing is measured.
definitions.paneFocus: Captured pointerdown on another pane to its data-focused DOM attribute and next requestAnimationFrame callback.
